scientific_integrity: Complete exact triaxially unrestricted John ellipsoid solution in three-dimensional two-ball lenses with unequal radii, using convex containment and an explicit isotropic contact measure; numerical tests are supplementary rather than proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only two Euclidean balls in R^3 with R>=r>0 and R-r<s<R+r, exact measurements and full-dimensional lens. No claims for higher dimensions, nested or tangent balls, robustness or exhaustive historical priority.
title: The sharp John-ellipsoid contact transition for unequal spherical lenses
